evidence.claim: Inspected the owning ARIA-NBV and VIN guidance files and searched the VIN model for constructors, forward methods, and setup_target usage.
Inspected VinModelV3 construction and forward implementation, including setup_target-related code and existing model configuration/call sites.

Verified statically that setup_target calls are in VinModelV3.__init__, while forward delegates to _forward_impl without constructing dependencies; attempted the focused VIN test and checked checkout status.

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n --hidden -g '"'!*.pyc'"' -g '"'!graphify-out/**'"' 'setup_target|class .*VIN|VIN|def forward\\(' . | head -240
rg --files | rg 'AGENTS\\.md"'$|vin|VIN|config|target'"' | head -160
git status --short"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,180p' aria_nbv/AGENTS.md
sed -n '1,220p' aria_nbv/aria_nbv/vin/AGENTS.md
rg -n 'class .*Vin|def forward|setup_target|__init__' aria_nbv/aria_nbv/vin | head -220"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,130p' .agents/skills/python-standards/references/general_conventions.md
sed -n '280,390p' aria_nbv/aria_nbv/vin/models/scene_myopic.py
sed -n '930,1025p' aria_nbv/aria_nbv/vin/models/scene_myopic.py
rg -n 'VinModelV3\\(|setup_target\\(\\).*Vin|model_config|VinModelV3Config' aria_nbv/tests aria_nbv/aria_nbv | head -180"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "set -o pipefail
printf '%s\\n' '--- setup_target calls in VIN model owner ---'
rg -n 'setup_target\\(' aria_nbv/aria_nbv/vin/models/scene_myopic.py
printf '%s\\n' '--- forward definitions and nearby dependency signature ---'
nl -ba aria_nbv/aria_nbv/vin/models/scene_myopic.py | sed -n '300,375p;948,1015p'
printf '%s\\n' '--- focused construction/forward proof ---'
cd aria_nbv && uv run pytest tests/vin/test_vin_model_v3_core.py -q
printf '%s\\n' '--- checkout status ---'
git status --short"
